title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) | OWASP Foundation: The standard provides a basis for testing application technical security control
content: The standard provides a basis for testing application technical security controls, as well as any technical security controls in the environment, that are relied on to protect against vulnerabilities such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and SQL injection.
